Vallvidrera, el Tibidabo i les Planes — Barcelona, Spain

Relatively safer day Average night

In detail

This is a low-density, largely forested hillside area; coverage centers on residential burglary of isolated houses. Metropoli Abierta (2022) reported 32 burglaries/attempted burglaries over 15 months in one area alone, mostly between 22:00-06:00, attributed to the hilly terrain and distance from police stations. No incidents were found involving the Tibidabo funicular, amusement park, or other tourist-facing spots. Sources checked: metropoliabierta.elespanol.com, Jun 2022.
